verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe declaring/running/resolving incidents from Slack, Google Chat, and Teams, with automatic channel creation, role assignment, and updates via workflows (e.g., rootly-docs-1, 34, 45) and in-channel AI summaries (rootly-docs-30/47). Community evidence (rootly-comm-1) confirms real-world adoption without contradicting the chat-declare flow.
